claims.statement: Pair source-qualified import-candidate routes on two exact revisions to examine actual architectural evolution, including newly introduced endpoints and bounded search limitations.

attributes.title: Paired committed architectural source routes

alignment.basis: Supports compounding product knowledge and actual architectural interventions under ADR 0038.

ambition.basis: Extends a proven bounded source inquiry rather than building a global dependency graph.

horizon.basis: Existing source-route and source-review tree classification supply direct implementation primitives.

realization.basis: At exact candidate 88c70753, hosted actual run 46102664225 rehearsed all eight contribution paths, matched before/after bytes, parsed all three Python modifications, and mechanically validated the proposed pack. On the fixed real #1014 target checkout, three pre/post operation payloads were identical (old and new single-ref routes and prior source-review comparison). The paired former-builder query retained the BASE one-hop witness and TARGET bounded no-witness, equal to standalone results. The new-boundary query reported BASE ABSENT_FROM_TREE/ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE and TARGET one-hop FOUND, with NOT_COMPARABLE; same-ref results were identical with zero hop delta; reverse comparison swapped the sides and disposition; one-file queries retained NOT_ASSESSED on both sides and NOT_COMPARABLE. Five returned witness occurrences matched committed SHA-256 source and actual import lines.

history.basis: Candidate code composed; actual historical-route comparison not yet observed.

disposition_history.authority: agent construction selection within delegated self-development
disposition_history.rationale: Select paired bounded evidence over manual-only reconciliation or global dependency inference.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Compose the existing bounded source-route builder with an exact committed regular-file classifier in the separated source_access boundary, preserving separate full results and identical per-revision bounds.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A development agent can compare the same directed architectural question across actual committed transitions without manually joining separately resolved source-route results or mistaking a missing endpoint for a negative search.
attributes.revisit_when: An actual historical source inquiry needs renamed endpoint matching, non-Python resolution or materially different bounds, or file:src/sensemaking_skills/semantic_architecture/source_relationships.py changes.
attributes.counterevidence: Separate source-route calls and manual inspection remain viable. The former mixed module could have implemented comparison too. A separated source boundary is a supporting design condition, not a necessary causal prerequisite; static witnesses are bounded, not runtime dependency or impact.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Observed scoped real historical comparison and source compatibility; original prospective frame retained. BASE co-design review truncated; non-regular endpoints and other architectures were not executed in this episode. No complete route graph, runtime dependency or global equivalence, causal reduction in development cost, independent cognitive benefit or cross-domain transfer established.

value_frame.would_change_decision_if: An endpoint is mistaken for a completed negative, source evidence is lost, same-revision results disagree, or actual agents find manual pairing preferable.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: One opt-in flag, shared low-level classifier, two bounded disposable queries at most; no new semantic ontology, no snapshot construction by comparison builder.
